summary.oneLiner: GIPCL is a low-cost Gujarat PSU generator (thermal is debt-free and top of merit order; off-take fully contracted with GUVNL) mid-way through a large solar build-out at Khavda. The **600 MW Khavda solar** was commissioned (Dec-2025, now running ~33% CUF, full firm evacuation) and a **500 MW second phase** is commissioning in stages through end-CY2026, gated by grid evacuation. Management guides FY27 group EBITDA of ~**Rs 940–950 cr** rising to **Rs 950–1,000 cr** once 500 MW runs a full year (FY28) — but PBT stays modest (~Rs 220 cr FY27) as interest + depreciation roughly double. A separate **750 MW lignite thermal (Rs 6,000–6,500 cr)** and **BESS/park/pumped-storage** optionality sit behind, funded by rising debt (peak ~Rs 6,000–6,500 cr) and possible equity dilution.

| Metric | FY26 | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Total revenue (topline) | ~Rs 1,500 cr | Breakdown given below |
| — SLPP-1 & 2 (lignite thermal) | ~Rs 1,103 cr | Bulk of revenue |
| — RE division | ~Rs 387 cr | Solar Rs 152 cr + Wind Rs 86 cr + 75 MW group solar Rs 38 cr + Khavda Rs 111 cr |
| Solar division EBITDA | Rs 332 cr | Guided to ~Rs 600 cr in FY27 |

| Interest (FY26) | Rs 107–110 cr | Only 1 quarter of 600 MW interest booked (commissioned Dec) |
| Depreciation (FY26) | Rs 187 cr | |
| Long-term borrowing (31-Mar-26) | Rs 3,250 cr (non-current) | CWIP Rs 2,065 cr = the 500 MW project |
| Avg coupon | 7.8%, **floating** | |
> One-offs distorting FY26: the ~Rs 260 cr tax-regime transition credit and the Rs 42 cr lumpy other income (Rs 17 cr IT refund + insurance). Thermal, existing solar & wind are essentially **debt-free** — only the Khavda 600 MW carries debt.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter:
- **Group EBITDA:** ~Rs 940–950 cr in **FY27** (600 MW full year + partial 500 MW); **Rs 950–1,000 cr once 500 MW runs a full year (FY28)**. "This year you will not see Rs 950–1,000 cr" — that's the FY28 run-rate.
- **Solar division EBITDA:** Rs 332 cr (FY26) → **~Rs 600 cr (FY27)**.
- **Revenue addition FY27:** ~**Rs 450 cr** on existing topline = Rs 400–430 cr from 600 MW Khavda + Rs 30–40 cr from RE-park O&M.
- **600 MW Khavda (FY27):** revenue ~**Rs 420 cr** (±5–10%), EBITDA **Rs 350–360 cr**, tariff **Rs 2.73/unit**, CUF **~30%+** (33% current quarter; monsoon dip in Q2, pick-up in Q3).
- **Blended solar CUF FY27:** ~29–30% (Khavda 29–30%, Raghanesda 28–29%).
- **FY27 PBT:** ~Rs 220 cr (modest — interest+depreciation roughly double).
- **FY27 interest ~Rs 250–270 cr; depreciation ~Rs 425–450 cr.** **FY28 interest ~Rs 400–450 cr; depreciation ~Rs 550–600 cr.**
- **Debt:** ~Rs 4,500 cr after 500 MW commissioning; **peak ~Rs 6,000–6,500 cr** once 750 MW lignite is added (phased).
- **500 MW Khavda:** capacity commissioned in phases through **end-CY2026** (post-monsoon ramp from Q3); revenue mostly from **FY28** (teething year first).
- **750 MW lignite thermal:** order placement targeted by **Q4 of current FY (FY27)**; commissioning **FY32–FY33**.
- Dividend: **"committed… we will pay what we are paying"** — maintained despite thin PBT.
order book & pipeline:
Not an order-book business — a regulated/PPA generator. Contracted pipeline:
- **Khavda solar park (own):** 1,100 MW allotted; 600 MW commissioned, 500 MW commissioning, + a further **200 MW** possible from land optimization (see §8). 25-yr PPA with GUVNL, firm allocation.
- **Raghanesda** solar operating (~28–29% CUF); wind and small/legacy solar operating.
- **RE-park developer role:** GIPCL developed 2,375 MW Khavda park infra; recurring O&M income (see §5).
segment / subsidiary detail:
- **Thermal (SLPP-1 & 2, lignite, Surat):** PLF >75% (SLPP-1) and >80% (SLPP-2); **top of merit order → no off-take/evacuation issue**; debt-free; ~Rs 1,103 cr FY26 revenue. South-Gujarat demand strong.
- **Khavda 600 MW solar:** commissioned Dec-2025, full firm evacuation allocation since Nov-2025, CUF 33% now (was 23% in Mar-25 quarter during teething). ~Rs 420 cr rev / Rs 350–360 cr EBITDA FY27.
- **Khavda 2,375 MW park (4,750 hectares):** GIPCL = **park developer** for infra/evacuation; own 1,100 MW; the other ~1,275 MW sold to third-party developers — **Coal India, SJVN, SAEL** — who sign their own PPAs directly with GUVNL. GIPCL earns only **O&M: ~Rs 50–60 cr peak revenue, net ~Rs 20–25 cr, for 25 years** (per MNRE terms).
- **Group/promoter solar (75 MW):** commissioned May last year, Rs 38 cr revenue for 9 months.
- **Gas stations (~310 MW: 145 MW from 1993 + 165 MW):** stranded ~6 years; capex fully recovered via past tariff (no book loss); **no revival expected** on geopolitical gas prices; management **considering hive-off in next couple of years**.
growth verticals / optionality:
- **500 MW Khavda phase-2** — near-term EBITDA step-up (~Rs 350 cr) once full-year FY28.
- **+200 MW Khavda** from land optimization (see §8) — FY27.
- **750 MW lignite thermal** (3×250) — long-dated (FY32–33) but under Section 62 **cost-plus** (regulated return), lignite secured.
- **BESS** at the idle Baroda gas site — pilot into a new revenue line (fixed capacity payment from GUVNL).
- **Pumped-storage** — "in the race" with Govt of Gujarat to secure sites.
- Medium-term: aims to add **~200–300 MW solar/yr** subject to land/connectivity ("actual reality is another thing").
margins & cost dynamics:
- Solar is high-margin (EBITDA ~Rs 350–360 cr on ~Rs 420 cr revenue for 600 MW ≈ ~85%); thermal lower — blended EBITDA margin high given solar mix rising.
- Tariff fixed under 25-yr PPAs (Rs 2.73/unit for Khavda 600 MW); a CUF margin buffer is built into the bid tariff to absorb weak-generation (monsoon/winter) years; below-benchmark CUF triggers a GUVNL penalty (no upper cap on generation — excess is still paid).
- Depreciation straight-line; company in **MAT**.
- Near-term EPS pressure: interest + depreciation roughly **double** in FY27 (to ~Rs 250–270 cr and ~Rs 425–450 cr) and again in FY28 — capping PBT even as EBITDA scales.
capex / expansion (watch slippage):
- **500 MW Khavda solar:** CWIP Rs 2,065 cr on books; **~Rs 1,500 cr further** investment to complete; commissioned in phases (50/100/200 MW blocks) through **end-CY2026**, gated by CTUIL evacuation readiness (post-monsoon). Revenue mostly FY28.
- **+200 MW Khavda:** land allotted was 75 MW, but optimization of the 4,750 ha frees a pocket for **200 MW**; **project cost Rs 800–1,000 cr**, expected "in a couple of months" (FY27); adds only ~Rs 200–300 cr debt.
- **750 MW lignite thermal (3×250):** GUVNL in-principle approval under **Section 62 cost-plus**; **tender floated, under evaluation by BHEL & others**; order by **Q4 FY27**; gestation 3–4 yrs → **commissioning FY32/FY33**; **capex Rs 6,000–6,500 cr**; financing **80:20** (~Rs 4,800 cr debt + ~Rs 1,200 cr equity); PPA with GUVNL for full capacity; **lignite secured** for 750+500 MW over full PPA life.
- **BESS (Baroda gas site):** reuse existing switchyard/evacuation; **20/120 MW** phase-1 (GUVNL-approved, tender in place) + planned **30/160 MW** next year; **capex Rs 250–300 cr**; pilot; ~Rs 6/unit; ~1 yr to full operation; fixed GUVNL revenue for storage.
- **Pumped-storage:** site identification with GoG (early stage).
capital allocation:
- **Debt:** post-500 MW ~Rs 4,500 cr; **peak ~Rs 6,000–6,500 cr** once 750 MW lignite is layered (phased 2027→2032/33). Coupon 7.8% floating. Khavda 600 MW moratorium ended Jun-2026; **step-up repayment starts next quarter** (light in first 5 yrs, then tops up).
- **Equity:** "no plans as of now" for the thermal Rs 1,200 cr equity slug — options flagged: **internal accrual over 5 yrs, promoter infusion, or equity dilution / market raise**. (A dilution risk investors should track.)
- **Dividend:** maintained ("committed… what we are paying") despite the FY27 PBT squeeze.
risks & watch-items:
- **Grid evacuation congestion at Khavda** — KPS-2 evacuation line not fully ready; new RE capacity being cleared **pro-rata by CTUIL**; the 500 MW ramp depends on **PGCIL connectivity** (mgmt expects by end-Jul; installs from Aug). (600 MW itself has firm full allocation — no curtailment.)
- **Commissioning slippage** on 500 MW (phased, post-monsoon, teething year) → revenue mostly FY28.
- **PBT squeeze:** interest + depreciation doubling → thin ~Rs 220 cr FY27 PBT; investor flagged **ROE ~13–14% only if gas assets excluded**, and stock **below book value**.
- **Equity dilution** risk for the Rs 6,000 cr thermal.
- **Stranded gas** (~310 MW) — dead weight, hive-off pending; revival tied to geopolitics/gas prices.
- **Monsoon CUF dip** each Q2; **CUF-penalty** risk if generation falls below PPA benchmark.
- Single-counterparty concentration on **GUVNL** (mitigated by merit-order priority; Gujarat demand > supply for 10 yrs, GIPCL curtailed last given low cost).
- 750 MW lignite is a **coal/lignite thermal add** in a decarbonizing world — long-dated, cost-plus, but a capital-heavy 4-yr build.
management quality / tone: First-ever con-call; CFO candid and accessible but **worked entirely from memory** — many figures explicitly "rough," repayment schedule/percentages not recalled, no deck. Repeatedly committed to quarterly calls + publishing PLF/CUF data and a numbers presentation going forward (investors pushed hard for both). Confident on merit-order position and off-take security; realistic on gas ("not going to be revived") and on medium-term RE adds ("actual reality is another thing"). Some investor confusion on FY27 vs FY28 interest/depreciation that the CFO had to untangle repeatedly — disclosure discipline is the improvement area.
non-obvious takeaways:
- **EBITDA scales, PBT doesn't (yet):** the headline "Rs 950–1,000 cr EBITDA" is FY28, not FY27, and interest+depreciation nearly wipe the incremental EBITDA → PBT ~flat-to-modest near term. Don't capitalize the EBITDA jump into earnings too early.
- **Park-developer economics are tiny:** 2,375 MW park sounds large but GIPCL keeps only **~Rs 20–25 cr net/yr** on the 1,275 MW third-party portion (O&M only) — the value is in its **own 1,100 MW** generation.
- **Thermal is the hidden ballast:** SLPP-1/2 are debt-free, top-of-merit-order, ~Rs 1,100 cr revenue — the cash engine funding the solar build.
- **CUF disclosure gap:** website CUF lags a quarter (WRLDC/SLDC validation ~1–1.5 months) and shows stale (23%) vs current 33% — a data-timing artefact, not a deterioration.
- **Land optimization = free 125 MW:** 75 MW allotment stretched to a 200 MW plan on the same 4,750 ha.

identity.name: GUJ IND POW CO. LTD
identity.industry: Power / Generation Utility — Solar-led RE + Lignite Thermal (Gujarat state PSU IPP)

hero.oneLiner: GIPCL is a low-cost Gujarat PSU generator (thermal is debt-free and top of merit order; off-take fully contracted with GUVNL) mid-way through a large solar build-out at Khavda. The **600 MW Khavda solar** was commissioned (Dec-2025, now running ~33% CUF, full firm evacuation) and a **500 MW second phase** is commissioning in stages through end-CY2026, gated by grid evacuation. Management guides FY27 group EBITDA of ~**Rs 940–950 cr** rising to **Rs 950–1,000 cr** once 500 MW runs a full year (FY28) — but PBT stays modest (~Rs 220 cr FY27) as interest + depreciation roughly double. A separate **750 MW lignite thermal (Rs 6,000–6,500 cr)** and **BESS/park/pumped-storage** optionality sit behind, funded by rising debt (peak ~Rs 6,000–6,500 cr) and possible equity dilution.
hero.industry: Power / Generation Utility — Solar-led RE + Lignite Thermal (Gujarat state PSU IPP)

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- "Basically, our all the stations are doing very well because we are top in the merit order, so generation-wise and power evacuation-wise, off-take there is no issue." Management argues that even if Gujarat turns surplus, "as per the merit order, those who are costly power supplier, they will be curtailed down first, GIPCL will not be impacted."
- Offtake is concentrated in GUVNL under long-tenure PPAs — Khavda PPA is "already in place" for 25 years; the 750 MW lignite expansion will also have "a PPA with the power offtaker GUVNL" for the entire capacity.
- On demand risk: "since last 10 years, there is no supply and demand mismatch. Demand is always more than the supply"; thermal faces "no evacuation issue in the region and there is a heavy demand of the power in the South Gujarat."
- PPA structure gives asymmetric volume risk: "there is no upper limit. Upper limit, whatever you are generating, you can push power and you will get the tariff. But lower side, there is a benchmark... If you are generating below that percentage, there is a penalty being imposed by GUVNL."
- Management explicitly frames the park role as non-core: "we are not in park developer business and we are always into the generation."

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body:
- **Thermal (SLPP-1 & 2, lignite, Surat):** PLF >75% (SLPP-1) and >80% (SLPP-2); **top of merit order → no off-take/evacuation issue**; debt-free; ~Rs 1,103 cr FY26 revenue. South-Gujarat demand strong.
- **Khavda 600 MW solar:** commissioned Dec-2025, full firm evacuation allocation since Nov-2025, CUF 33% now (was 23% in Mar-25 quarter during teething). ~Rs 420 cr rev / Rs 350–360 cr EBITDA FY27.
- **Khavda 2,375 MW park (4,750 hectares):** GIPCL = **park developer** for infra/evacuation; own 1,100 MW; the other ~1,275 MW sold to third-party developers — **Coal India, SJVN, SAEL** — who sign their own PPAs directly with GUVNL. GIPCL earns only **O&M: ~Rs 50–60 cr peak revenue, net ~Rs 20–25 cr, for 25 years** (per MNRE terms).
- **Group/promoter solar (75 MW):** commissioned May last year, Rs 38 cr revenue for 9 months.
- **Gas stations (~310 MW: 145 MW from 1993 + 165 MW):** stranded ~6 years; capex fully recovered via past tariff (no book loss); **no revival expected** on geopolitical gas prices; management **considering hive-off in next couple of years**.

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body:
Not an order-book business — a regulated/PPA generator. Contracted pipeline:
- **Khavda solar park (own):** 1,100 MW allotted; 600 MW commissioned, 500 MW commissioning, + a further **200 MW** possible from land optimization (see §8). 25-yr PPA with GUVNL, firm allocation.
- **Raghanesda** solar operating (~28–29% CUF); wind and small/legacy solar operating.
- **RE-park developer role:** GIPCL developed 2,375 MW Khavda park infra; recurring O&M income (see §5).

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)
guidance.body:
- **Group EBITDA:** ~Rs 940–950 cr in **FY27** (600 MW full year + partial 500 MW); **Rs 950–1,000 cr once 500 MW runs a full year (FY28)**. "This year you will not see Rs 950–1,000 cr" — that's the FY28 run-rate.
- **Solar division EBITDA:** Rs 332 cr (FY26) → **~Rs 600 cr (FY27)**.
- **Revenue addition FY27:** ~**Rs 450 cr** on existing topline = Rs 400–430 cr from 600 MW Khavda + Rs 30–40 cr from RE-park O&M.
- **600 MW Khavda (FY27):** revenue ~**Rs 420 cr** (±5–10%), EBITDA **Rs 350–360 cr**, tariff **Rs 2.73/unit**, CUF **~30%+** (33% current quarter; monsoon dip in Q2, pick-up in Q3).
- **Blended solar CUF FY27:** ~29–30% (Khavda 29–30%, Raghanesda 28–29%).
- **FY27 PBT:** ~Rs 220 cr (modest — interest+depreciation roughly double).
- **FY27 interest ~Rs 250–270 cr; depreciation ~Rs 425–450 cr.** **FY28 interest ~Rs 400–450 cr; depreciation ~Rs 550–600 cr.**
- **Debt:** ~Rs 4,500 cr after 500 MW commissioning; **peak ~Rs 6,000–6,500 cr** once 750 MW lignite is added (phased).
- **500 MW Khavda:** capacity commissioned in phases through **end-CY2026** (post-monsoon ramp from Q3); revenue mostly from **FY28** (teething year first).
- **750 MW lignite thermal:** order placement targeted by **Q4 of current FY (FY27)**; commissioning **FY32–FY33**.
- Dividend: **"committed… we will pay what we are paying"** — maintained despite thin PBT.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **500 MW Khavda phase-2** — near-term EBITDA step-up (~Rs 350 cr) once full-year FY28.
- **+200 MW Khavda** from land optimization (see §8) — FY27.
- **750 MW lignite thermal** (3×250) — long-dated (FY32–33) but under Section 62 **cost-plus** (regulated return), lignite secured.
- **BESS** at the idle Baroda gas site — pilot into a new revenue line (fixed capacity payment from GUVNL).
- **Pumped-storage** — "in the race" with Govt of Gujarat to secure sites.
- Medium-term: aims to add **~200–300 MW solar/yr** subject to land/connectivity ("actual reality is another thing").

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body:
- Solar is high-margin (EBITDA ~Rs 350–360 cr on ~Rs 420 cr revenue for 600 MW ≈ ~85%); thermal lower — blended EBITDA margin high given solar mix rising.
- Tariff fixed under 25-yr PPAs (Rs 2.73/unit for Khavda 600 MW); a CUF margin buffer is built into the bid tariff to absorb weak-generation (monsoon/winter) years; below-benchmark CUF triggers a GUVNL penalty (no upper cap on generation — excess is still paid).
- Depreciation straight-line; company in **MAT**.
- Near-term EPS pressure: interest + depreciation roughly **double** in FY27 (to ~Rs 250–270 cr and ~Rs 425–450 cr) and again in FY28 — capping PBT even as EBITDA scales.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- **Debt:** post-500 MW ~Rs 4,500 cr; **peak ~Rs 6,000–6,500 cr** once 750 MW lignite is layered (phased 2027→2032/33). Coupon 7.8% floating. Khavda 600 MW moratorium ended Jun-2026; **step-up repayment starts next quarter** (light in first 5 yrs, then tops up).
- **Equity:** "no plans as of now" for the thermal Rs 1,200 cr equity slug — options flagged: **internal accrual over 5 yrs, promoter infusion, or equity dilution / market raise**. (A dilution risk investors should track.)
- **Dividend:** maintained ("committed… what we are paying") despite the FY27 PBT squeeze.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: First-ever con-call; CFO candid and accessible but **worked entirely from memory** — many figures explicitly "rough," repayment schedule/percentages not recalled, no deck. Repeatedly committed to quarterly calls + publishing PLF/CUF data and a numbers presentation going forward (investors pushed hard for both). Confident on merit-order position and off-take security; realistic on gas ("not going to be revived") and on medium-term RE adds ("actual reality is another thing"). Some investor confusion on FY27 vs FY28 interest/depreciation that the CFO had to untangle repeatedly — disclosure discipline is the improvement area.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body:
- **Grid evacuation congestion at Khavda** — KPS-2 evacuation line not fully ready; new RE capacity being cleared **pro-rata by CTUIL**; the 500 MW ramp depends on **PGCIL connectivity** (mgmt expects by end-Jul; installs from Aug). (600 MW itself has firm full allocation — no curtailment.)
- **Commissioning slippage** on 500 MW (phased, post-monsoon, teething year) → revenue mostly FY28.
- **PBT squeeze:** interest + depreciation doubling → thin ~Rs 220 cr FY27 PBT; investor flagged **ROE ~13–14% only if gas assets excluded**, and stock **below book value**.
- **Equity dilution** risk for the Rs 6,000 cr thermal.
- **Stranded gas** (~310 MW) — dead weight, hive-off pending; revival tied to geopolitics/gas prices.
- **Monsoon CUF dip** each Q2; **CUF-penalty** risk if generation falls below PPA benchmark.
- Single-counterparty concentration on **GUVNL** (mitigated by merit-order priority; Gujarat demand > supply for 10 yrs, GIPCL curtailed last given low cost).
- 750 MW lignite is a **coal/lignite thermal add** in a decarbonizing world — long-dated, cost-plus, but a capital-heavy 4-yr build.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body:
- **EBITDA scales, PBT doesn't (yet):** the headline "Rs 950–1,000 cr EBITDA" is FY28, not FY27, and interest+depreciation nearly wipe the incremental EBITDA → PBT ~flat-to-modest near term. Don't capitalize the EBITDA jump into earnings too early.
- **Park-developer economics are tiny:** 2,375 MW park sounds large but GIPCL keeps only **~Rs 20–25 cr net/yr** on the 1,275 MW third-party portion (O&M only) — the value is in its **own 1,100 MW** generation.
- **Thermal is the hidden ballast:** SLPP-1/2 are debt-free, top-of-merit-order, ~Rs 1,100 cr revenue — the cash engine funding the solar build.
- **CUF disclosure gap:** website CUF lags a quarter (WRLDC/SLDC validation ~1–1.5 months) and shows stale (23%) vs current 33% — a data-timing artefact, not a deterioration.
- **Land optimization = free 125 MW:** 75 MW allotment stretched to a 200 MW plan on the same 4,750 ha.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Accounting] User development charge and government subsidy at the park are capitalised, not revenue: "UDC is a capital payment, upfront development charge. That is not an income"; they reach the P&L only "in the form of amortization. It is just like depreciation." Depreciation method is straight-line.
- [Tax] "We are not having any tax expense as such in any of the division. Tax is being taken as a company as a whole, and we are in MAT", so divisional PAT is not reported.
- [Disclosure] Repeated investor pressure for better disclosure — management agreed to consider publishing PLF data on BSE/NSE, to hold calls regularly, and to provide a tabular presentation of figures. Monthly/quarterly generation is withheld because data "is getting validated by WRLDC and SLDC, which takes around 1 months, 1.5 months."
- [Related party] A 75 MW "group power plant... with your promoters" was commissioned in May of the prior year and generated revenue of about Rs 38 crores over 9 months.
- [Guidance conflict] FY26-27 depreciation and interest were given two different ways in the same call (see notes); management pushed back on the resulting investor arithmetic — "EBITDA. You are, I think, missing the figures of '25, '26 and '26, '27" — and put FY26-27 PBT at "around 220 crores".
